ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels and 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels visible on the right lobe surface; left lobe is predominantly low-intensity due to shadow.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering the proximal and dorsal sections of the fluke; a high-intensity contiguous region occupies the distal-ventral portion of the right lobe, featuring a mottled transition zone with small dark pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-degree angle and a vertical depth ratio of roughly 0.15 relative to visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge shows high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixel height) interspersed with larger irregular protrusions caused by barnacle attachments; left lobe edge is irregular and jagged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a broad convex curve from the median notch to the tip; left lobe trajectory is partially obscured by water and perspective.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of approximately 18-22 circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) located along the trailing edge and dorsal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, vertically oriented, near-parallel linear pixel disruptions (dark rake marks) located on the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the right lobe trailing edge and parallel vertical scarring on the ventral right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Small isolated dark focal spots (mottling) within the predominantly white region of the distal right lobe.
